signal: Clearspeed raised a $60M Series D in June 2025 (total $110M) to expand its voice-based risk assessment platform across insurers and financial institutions in 37 countries

email.body1:
Justin, saw Clearspeed closed a $60M Series D and is expanding voice-based risk assessment across insurers and financial institutions.

Expansion that fast usually shifts the bottleneck to signal-to-action latency: in-market accounts surface but nobody acts before they cool. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, sequenced outreach autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Clearspeed off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Justin, quick follow-up.

In most RevOps stacks the lift hides in latency and hygiene, not effort. Reps burn hours on research, writing, and CRM logging, so the signals that matter get touched late or not at all, and the lift never lands in the numbers.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of Clearspeed's current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Justin, last bit of proof for Clearspeed.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Clearspeed's reply rate likely compares to other Series-D startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Justin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't on the RevOps roadmap this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling into new markets is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Clearspeed either way.
